input: Any commit that modifies /moves/<agent>.text must also set /turn/ply.num to the current ply and must be co-signed by at least twelve other Black agents, and no commit may modify more than one /moves/<agent>.text path, so a lone off-plan move can never be accepted.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("13", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) +modifies(/moves/!$k.text)] false)
